accountId.description: The unique Zywave identifier for the account tied to the policy.

policyCoverageTypeId.description: The type of coverage for the policy. Ex. Medical, Dental, etc. Has a dependency on a policy coverage type item.  Please use the policy coverage type endpoint for reference.

carrierCompanyId.description: The carrier company tied to the policy.  Has a dependency on a carrier company item.  Please use the Carriers API for reference.

beginningPolicyStatusId.description: The identifier for the status of the policy when it is created.  Has a dependency on a policy status item.  Please use the policy status endpoint for reference.

effectiveDate.description: The date that the policy becomes effective.

expirationDate.description: The date that the policy expires.

fundingType.description: The funding type for the policy.

productType.description: The product type for the policy.

isVoluntary.description: Denotes if a policy is voluntary.

firstWrittenDate.description: The date that the policy was first written. Must be less than or equal to ExpirationDate.

cancellationDate.description: The date that the policy was cancelled.

reinstatementDate.description: The date that the policy was reinstated.

policyNumber.description: The carrier's identifier for the policy.

rateType.description: The type of rate for the policy. Ex. Tiered

endingPolicyStatusId.description: The identifier for the status of the policy at the end of its term.  Has a dependency on a policy status item.  Please use the policy status endpoint for reference.

departmentId.description: The identifier for the department related to the policy.

carrierCommissionToAgencyPaymentSchedule.description: The identifier for the carrier commission to agency payment schedule related to the policy.

needsReview.description: Denotes if a policy needs to be reviewed.

policyGroupId.description: Denotes the policy group ID that this policy belongs to.

vendorSourceId.description: Denotes the source ID of the vendor (requires CarrierCompanyId to be -1).

vendorSourceType.description: Denotes the source type of the vendor (requires CarrierCompanyId to be -1).

vendorSourceEntityName.description: Denotes the source entity name of the vendor (requires CarrierCompanyId to be -1).
